notes: Multistandard video & audio sync/reference generator (genlock + word clock generator); no "sync generator" type exists in the given type enum so "Other" was used — category "other" for the same reason (it doesn't source/switch/convert AV content, it generates timing references). Discontinued/EOL (manufacturer page marks it "sold out" as of 3/2023, support only). Shipped in two fixed mains variants selected by an internal slide switch: 115VAC/60Hz or 230VAC/50Hz, ~10W (rear-panel photo on one unit reads "230VAC 60mA 50Hz" — minor label variance across production runs, same IEC inlet). AES1/AES2 outputs are AES/EBU (AES3) signals delivered on 3-pin male XLR connectors — connector set to "xlr3" (the physical connector) rather than the separate "aes3" enum id, since AES3 there appears to denote a different physical form (e.g. 75-ohm coax); no bandwidth-grade scale applies to AES/EBU so grade was omitted. All BNC video-sync (VO1-VO6, SD/HD video sync input) and word-clock (WORD CLOCK in, WO1-WO8) ports carry analog reference/clock signals, not SDI payloads, so no sdi-* grade applies despite the BNC connector. LTC in/out confirmed as RCA jacks per manual text (C9/C10), not the smaller TRS jacks a rear-panel photo might suggest at a glance. USB port is a single USB-B, "USB 2.0 MIDI device class compliant" (device-class MIDI over USB to host computer for MTC/MMC and firmware update) — graded usb-2.0 and marked bidirectional per the stated convention for USB host-facing ports.
